2124602910407270636.en_summary: The Nvidia situation is evolving. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has completely changed his view on $NVDA over the last 7 days. Last Sunday, Bessent called for a “dramatic shakeup” at Nvidia and said its board needed to hire a new CEO from “outside” the company. Today, on Jensen Huang returning as CEO, Bessent said “Well, Jensen is on the outside now.” and “I think we have to see where the buck stops,” clearly leaving the door open. This comes just 2 days after President Trump publicly said Jensen Huang should “apologize and return.” Something is happening behind the scenes.
2124602910407270636.zh_summary: Nvidia情況正在演變。美國財政部長Scott Bessent過去7天對$NVDA的看法完全改變。上週日，Bessent呼籲Nvidia進行「戲劇性重組」，並表示其董事會需要從「外部」聘請新CEO。今天，被問及Jensen Huang回歸擔任CEO時，Bessent說「Well, Jensen is on the outside now。」以及「我認為我們必須看看責任止於何處」，明顯留有餘地。這發生在總統特朗普公開說Jensen Huang應該「道歉並回歸」的2天後。幕後有事情正在發生。
